messages:
samir: Hey all — finished Okta setup but I can’t see the eng shared Drive folder. I can sign into Okta and Google, but Drive shows only 'My Drive'. Anyone seen this before?

lila_it: @samir usually group sync issue. Are you in eng-all and redwood-drive-eng in Google?

samir: I only see 'All Employees' in my account. How do I check the groups?

lila_it: In Google Workspace web UI: go to your account > Manage > Directory > Groups. But easiest: run `gcloud identity groups memberships list --member-email samir@redwood.com` if you have gcloud access.

samir: don’t have gcloud set up yet. Can someone confirm if my account was added to the groups on the Okta side?

maya: I triggered provisioning for your account yesterday, @samir. Okta shows successful provisioning but sometimes the SAML attribute mapping for groups doesn’t push the right group. Lila, can you look at the SAML attribute map for samir?

lila_it: Checking now — looks like our Okta -> Google mapping has 'groupNames' attribute, but I see samir is missing the eng-all membership on the Okta side. I’ll add him to the Okta group which should sync over within ~10m.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: group-sync job queued (job id: gs-2026-03-23-77). Estimated completion 8m.

samir: Thanks. Also quick second thing — I got a 1Password invite but the link expired when I tried. Can someone resend? 1password-cli is needed for dev envs.

1password-bot: Invite resent to samir@redwood.com. Expires in 7 days.

samir: perfect. One more — trying to get SSH working with a YubiKey for security key signing; followed the dev docs but `ssh-add -L` shows nothing. My yubikey shows up in `ykman list`. Anyone set up hardware-backed ssh signing recently?

dan: I did mine last week. Two things: 1) Confirm you created an OpenPGP or PIV key on the YubiKey per our guide. We use PIV for ssh. 2) Make sure `ssh -v` shows a PKCS11 provider path when you attempt auth. Example `ssh -I /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/opensc-pkcs11.so git@github.com`

samir: I used the PIV instructions. On Mac, I have `opensc` from brew. `ssh -I /usr/local/lib/opensc-pkcs11.so` still didn’t list keys.

dan: On mac you also need to ensure the SSH agent is loaded with PKCS11: `ssh-add -s /usr/local/lib/opensc-pkcs11.so`. If you get `could not start agent` try `launchctl load /Library/LaunchAgents/org.opensc.*` or run the agent manually: `eval "$(ssh-agent -s)" && ssh-add -s /usr/local/lib/opensc-pkcs11.so`

samir: I ran `eval "$(ssh-agent -s)"` then `ssh-add -s ...` and it asked for PIN, entered it, then `ssh-add -L` shows the public key now. Nice.

lila_it: Back to groups — the sync finished and you should be in redwood-drive-eng now. You might need to sign out/in of Google or clear cache.

samir: I can see the folder now, thank you!! :tada:

maya: Great. For the 1Password invite: once you accept, enable 2FA in the app and confirm CLI access by running `op account add --address https://redwood.1password.com` then `op signin`. Ping @dan if the CLI token isn't working with our CI.

samir: Will do. Couple of notes for the docs team — my Okta got provisioned but group mapping was missing eng-all; maybe add a checklist step to verify group sync within 15 minutes of provisioning. Happy to draft a quick blurb.

lila_it: That’d be super helpful. If you draft it I’ll add exact SAML attribute names to the doc.

samir: Drafted and posted in #docs-drafts, link: https://redwood.internal/docs-drafts/1968001234 — feedback welcome.

dan: One last tip re: YubiKey on mac — if you hit weird timeouts, update firmware and check `ykman` version. Also remember to export your public key to GitHub if you use the key for repo access.

samir: Thanks everyone — everything working now. Appreciate the quick help.

lila_it: Welcome aboard, @samir! Ping here if anything else pops up.

maya: Welcome! :wave:
